790650101.text: Well done, my fine, hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, well done indeed! This jumping contest is. On. Fireeee!

790650102.text: Just a moment ago, we saw Estampe the Fearless show his awesome might!

790650103.text: With his impressive, epic strength, he's made a stable yet distant leap, one worthy of a favorite to take gold!

790650104.text: But next up, we have... The one you've all been waiting for! The unequalled! The unrivaled! The unparalleled...

790650106.text: *cough*... Who will emerge as champion, and win the great honor and burden of fetching the princess?

790650107.text: Before the final round begins, let us take a short break and give our two contestants time to rest.

790650108.text: For the time being, the competition venue will be open to you all, so go forth and jump to your hearts' content! That is what the Rainsong Pond is here for, after all!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Excited Paper Frog

790651401.text: Greetings, honored guests. You don't seem like frogs.

790651402.text: Nonetheless... Welcome to Rainsong Pond. May your legs be limber!

790651404.text: As you have seen and heard, this contest is to decide the frog who's best at jumping.

790651405.text: Our contestants go through the qualifiers, group matches, and elimination matches, and only those who make it through all these can reach the finals.

790651407.text: It's not complicated at all. Simply step into the arena and clear the challenges that lie before you!

790651408.text: Dear guests, if it suits your fancy, you can also try out the "Bouncing Contest" here!

790651409.text: This is meant to test the contestants' speed and stability when jumping. I was just about to do some practice here, then take part in the next contest.

790651410.text: But my skills aren't exactly up to par. I can't jump well enough on my own. Would you two be willing to assist me?

790651412.text: Of course. The competition's already reached the finals, so the other venues are now open for practice.

790651413.text: Keep practicing, keep jumping, keep competing — that's the way you get better and better!

790651414.text: Come on, dear guests! You'll enjoy the Bouncing Contest too, I guarantee it!

790651416.text: P—Paimon can fly, so uh, she doesn't have much use for jumping.

790651417.text: You've got the wrong end of the stick. It's not about being good or not, or whether you need to jump or not.

790651418.text: The word "contest" is the key. It is the spirit of competition itself that keeps us lively and spry!

790651419.text: So come, dear guests! You'll enjoy the Bouncing Contest too, I guarantee it!

subQuests.subQuestName: Practice with the Excited Paper Frog

790650801.text: *sigh* I hope everyone'll be able to do their best today — and that they won't give up even if they fall into the pond.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Excited Paper Frog

790650601.text: Heh. This game is pretty fun, don't you think? Paimon wants to give it a try, too.

790650603.text: P—Paimon can pose as if she's jumping in the air too, you know? It's pretty much the same, anyway...

790650604.text: Hahaha, I knew you'd enjoy the Bouncing Contest!

790650605.text: But just now... That was just a "game." This is a long way off from a real "contest."

790650606.text: Only the very best of the best of us can take part in the latter!

790650607.text: And this contest will decide who is best suited to rescue the princess... Ah, it's just so exciting!

790650608.text: Oh, sorry, dear guests. My apologies... I just can't help but ramble on about Faurobert.

790650609.text: After all, the whole reason we've organized so many contests was to choose the paper frog with the steadiest, furthest, most awe-inspiring jump so that they could go rescue the princess!

790650610.text: There's still some time before the final match begins, so feel free to take a look around.

790650611.text: Horellou will use his booming voice to remind us when the competition is about to begin, so listen out for it, and make sure you find good seats.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Calm Paper Frog

790651501.text: Welcome, dear guests. I presume you are also here to watch the competition? Welcome, in any case, to Rainsong Pond.

790651502.text: You have come at the right time... but also perhaps the wrong one. The competition is coming to a close, with only the final — the result of which is already beyond doubt — left to take place.

790651503.text: I'm sure you have heard of Faurobert and Estampe. They are both leading exponents in the art of jumping, but in my experience, Faurobert is sure to win.

790651504.text: Faurobert is far better at this than all other paper frogs, and has won countless championships as a result — he is, therefore, the undisputed favorite.

790651505.text: He has the strongest legs, the most agile mind, the most resolute spirit... Most importantly, he constantly seeks to share his know-how with all other frogs.

790651506.text: Estampe is, like me, one of the paper frogs who learned by watching him... We respect, trust, and believe that he will once again achieve great success.

790651507.text: Before the final begins, I'd like to stay and practice a little longer to prepare for the next round of competitions.

790651508.text: If you do not mind, we could practice together. Perhaps you might even come up with some good ideas to help me jump all the better.

790651511.text: Of course. This is not just about rescuing the princess.

790651512.text: Most important is the "contest" itself, and what it teaches us — self-belief, resolve, bravery...

790651513.text: Only a paper frog who understands and embodies such virtues will emerge as our champion.

790651514.text: Come then, dear guests. Hehe... Let's see if you can feel the virtue inherent in our contest.

subQuests.subQuestName: Practice with the Calm Paper Frog

790651102.text: Ah, there you are. The award ceremony is over, then?

790651103.text: Just the opposite, in fact! Both Mr. Horellou and I are of the opinion that things are far from over.

790651104.text: Indeed. I hereby announce, in my capacity as referee, that you, Mr. Faurobert, have one more chance to jump.

790651105.text: To maintain the fairness of this competition, and to fulfill our duty to the calling, you must do a re-jump.

790651106.text: Dear Mr. Horellou, I, as a contestant, cite the competition rules pertaining to competitive behavior that may bring harm to oneself and one's tribe...

790651107.text: I forfeit my second jump attempt... I do not want to disappoint everyone again, nor bring ruin to our calling. This is the only truly responsible course of action.

790651108.text: Wow, what a professional answer. He even had the specific clauses handy!

790651109.text: He even gave it a touch of emotional appeal...

790651110.text: Alright, looks like playing hardball isn't going to work! Oh, lucent dew and lotus leaves...

790651111.text: But you haven't left the venue.

790651112.text: ...I don't understand what you mean to say, dear guest.

790651114.text: Huh... You're right! You can see everything that's going on in the long-distance jumping contest from here!

790651115.text: If he really had given up and no longer wanted to have anything to do with the contest... Why would he stay?

790651120.text: I don't wish to talk about this anymore. I believe I've been clear. Sorry, Estampe, and our two guests as well.

790651117.text: Th—That's true. You can see everything that's going on in the long-distance jumping contest from here!

790651118.text: If he really had given up and no longer wanted to have anything to do with the contest... Why would he stay?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Calm Paper Frog

790650701.text: Not bad. You're quite good at this! If you have time, I'd be willing to recommend you to the organizing committee.

790650702.text: The next time we hold this competition, we'll be able to measure ourselves against one another.

790650703.text: Still, I shan't take up more of your time until then. The final is about to begin.

790650704.text: Hehe, guess we'll have to see just how good this Faurobert guy is.

790650705.text: He'll blow your socks off for sure! Still, he did seem a bit nervous when I saw him recently...

790650706.text: He was constantly practicing the most basic moves... and then getting annoyed at how he was performing them.

790650707.text: But these are the finals. It's normal to get nervous, right?

790650711.text: No, I still believe in him. He's not the type to give in so easily.

790650712.text: I've got to keep practicing myself. If you'd like, dear guests, please feel free to have a look around.

790650713.text: The finals are about to begin, though, so be sure you don't miss them.

790651901.text: Would you look. At. That! Faurobert the Unyielding! Faurobert the Bold! He's seized the opportunity for a retry — and... *gasp*! A spectacular leap. Spectacular indeed!

790651902.text: This is a miracle, without precedent! He is... the only paper frog ever to leap across this precipice!

790651903.text: I knew you had it in you, Faurobert! I believed in you!

790651904.text: The lotus leaf that suddenly started moving — that was your doing, wasn't it?

790651905.text: It was something that Mr. Horellou and I came up with together. I apologize, dear guests, for hiding this from you.

790651912.text: Alright then, Faurobert. Now that everyone has witnessed your great leap — you no longer have any reason to reject the victor's crown.

790651913.text: But it was a coincidence, a miracle born of circumstances! Just one... one fluke leap.

790651914.text: It was only with the aid of these two guests that I was able to do it at all.

790651915.text: I'll be honest, we were just having fun drifting alongside you.

790651916.text: Exactly, we were just watching from the sidelines. That big jump was all you.

790651917.text: Still, our work wasn't in vain.

790651918.text: Right? Hehe, it would've been a waste to stand by and watch such a brilliant... frog give up like that.

790651919.text: You love it so much, and you trained so hard for so long — it would've been awful if you'd just given up.

790651909.text: I am truly sorry. I have spoken to Mr. Horellou, and we will surely compensate you for the fright we caused.

790651910.text: To be sure, we did place a great many lotus pads in the waters beneath you. Even if you had fallen, you would not have been injured.

790651911.text: We would never allow guests to be harmed — I swear it by the good name of Rainsong Pond.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Excited Paper Frog

790652201.text: *sigh* I hope everyone'll be able to do their best today — and that they won't give up even if they fall into the pond.

790652101.text: Faurobert... I can only hope that you're in better shape now...

790650201.text: And here it is, here it comes! My fine hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, the unparalleled Faurobert steps forward to make his leap! And he—

790650202.text: ...He jumped three lotus leaves... and fell into the water...

790650203.text: I—It seems we have a champion — the one who will welcome our princess is Estampeee! Congratulations to our—

790650204.text: No! Mr. Horellou, I protest! This is ridiculous — absurd, even! I shall not accept the title of champion in this manner.

790650205.text: Goodness gracious, by the morning dew... Come now, you surpassed Faurobert in front of all frogkind!

790650206.text: Faurobert slipped up, that's all... He's just not in good form, you know?

790650207.text: That will not convince me, nor any other paper frogs! Anyway, let's give Faurobert a moment to himself... Hmm, we'll continue this later — it seems we have guests.

790650208.text: Welcome, welcome to Rainsong Pond. What can I help you with?

790650210.text: As you can see, it is a jumping contest.

790650211.text: Only the most legendary leaper may take the crown, thus earning the great burden of rescuing the princess... This is why we organize so many contests.

790650212.text: I imagine that you saw the frog who just made his leap... That was Faurobert, one of our contestants, and the greatest jumper in all the pond... or he used to be, anyway.

790650218.text: Huh, sounds pretty cool! Shame we seem to have missed it all, though...

790650214.text: Ah, then you must've caught sight of Faurobert. He is one of the participants in this contest, and the finest jumper in all the pond... or so he once was.

790650215.text: A contest? Ooh, Paimon gets it. This must be that sorta competition to see who can jump the best.

790650216.text: Very sharp of you, young lady. That is exactly the sort of competition we're running.

790650217.text: Only the most legendary leaper and skilled skipper may take the crown, thus earning the great burden of rescuing the princess.

790651604.text: Is there anything else I can help you with, dear guests? You saw the terrible state I was in.

790651605.text: ...I admit, I mostly knew what you were going to say the moment I saw you arriving with Estampe.

790651606.text: My answer is "no," and so it will always be.

790651607.text: Look at my ankles... They are not ankles that can carry such a heavy burden. Not ones that can save a princess.

790650301.text: H—Hey, don't go! We just wanna tell you one thing, one last thing!

790650304.text: Good guest, you do not understand. I... I initially believed that mistakes were mere drops of dew that fall upon our heads. Nothing that could truly knock a froggy down.

790650305.text: But I was wrong. Perhaps they were never mere drops but rather more akin to rocks at the bottom of a pond, withered wood stuck into the waterbed, or a vent hidden within the muck.

790650306.text: We can overlook them, bury them, step over them, or pretend they don't exist.

790650307.text: But they will not rest, my friend. They will await their opportunity, for a chance to come back to bite you.

790650308.text: Please go, and let me go too. I am nothing but a mere Lotus Head who has had all its seeds removed.

790650309.text: Even a light breeze would surge through the many holes in my heart and chill me to the bone.

790650310.text: I cannot take up this great burden. This is the voice of my heart. I have let all frogs down — including myself.

790650311.text: You still have a retry, you know.

790650312.text: Yeah, you've got another chance to prove yourself!

790650313.text: ...I do not wish to taste the bitter pang of failure once more. My legs and my heart cannot...

790650314.text: Whoa! This lotus leaf is moving all of a sudden. What's going on!?

790650315.text: What? But it should have been fixed in place...

790650316.text: ...No, it's moving forward. Please stand firm, dear guests. I will steer it as best I can!

790652301.text: The paper frog that jumps the highest will always have the furthest to fall... I hope they're ready...

790650401.text: Would you look. At. That! Faurobert the Unyielding! Faurobert the Bold! He's seized the opportunity for a retry — and... *gasp*! A spectacular leap. Spectacular indeed!

790650402.text: This is a miracle, without precedent! He is... the only paper frog ever to leap across this precipice!

790650403.text: I knew you had it in you, Faurobert! I believed in you!

790650404.text: The lotus leaf that suddenly started moving — that was your doing, wasn't it?

790650405.text: It was something that Mr. Horellou and I came up with together. I apologize, dear guests, for hiding this from you.

790650412.text: Alright then, Faurobert. Now that everyone has witnessed your great leap — you no longer have any reason to reject the victor's crown.

790650413.text: But it was a coincidence, a miracle born of circumstances! Just one... one fluke leap.

790650414.text: It was only with the aid of these two guests that I was able to do it at all.

790650415.text: I'll be honest, we were just having fun drifting alongside you.

790650416.text: Exactly, we were just watching from the sidelines. That big jump was all you.

790650417.text: Still, our work wasn't in vain.

790650418.text: Right? Hehe, it would've been a waste to stand by and watch such a brilliant... frog give up like that.

790650419.text: You love it so much, and you trained so hard for so long — it would've been awful if you'd just given up.

790650409.text: I am truly sorry. I have spoken to Mr. Horellou, and we will surely compensate you for the fright we caused.

790650410.text: To be sure, we did place a great many lotus pads in the waters beneath you. Even if you had fallen, you would not have been injured.

790650411.text: We would never allow guests to be harmed — I swear it by the good name of Rainsong Pond.

790651301.text: Failure is a deep pond indeed, doubt is the choking algae, and avoidance is the shackling sludge.

790651302.text: Faurobert, Faurobert, Faurobert, how are you going to hop out of this one...

790650901.text: The paper frog that jumps the highest will always have the furthest to fall... I hope they're ready...

790651201.text: Poor Faurobert. We've squashed that poor froggy flat under the weight of our expectations.

790651202.text: *sigh* If you ask me, winning all the time does a frog no good. The tallest Lotus Head always breaks first, as they say.

790651701.text: Faurobert, I know how nervous you are right now, but this is the final match that every frog has been looking forward to. You...

790651702.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Horellou, but I... I...

790651703.text: Please don't blame him, sir. Give him a moment to rest.

790651704.text: After all, Faurobert, I'm sure you need some time to think about how you shall pleasantly surprise us all.

790651705.text: Estampe... You're good enough. I think—

790651706.text: Oh, save it, friend. You will no doubt set a new record in just a moment. Trust me.

790651707.text: For now, just rest. You need time.

790651708.text: ... Alright. You're right, my friend. I need some time...

790651801.text: Well done, my fine, hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, well done indeed! This jumping contest is. On. Fireeee!

790651802.text: Just a moment ago, we saw Estampe the Fearless show his awesome might!

790651803.text: With his impressive, epic strength, he's made a stable yet distant leap, one worthy of a favorite to take gold!

790651804.text: But next up, we have... The one you've all been waiting for! The unequalled! The unrivaled! The unparalleled...

790651806.text: *cough*... Who will emerge as champion, and win the great honor and burden of fetching the princess?

790651807.text: They want to fetch the princess? Wait a minute...

790651808.text: So the one Princess Cimest was looking for was...

790651809.text: Th—That's gotta be a coincidence, right? But if that's the case, then this should save her a whole lot of effort!

790651810.text: Hehe, guess we've done our duty as the "Paladins of Breezes and Bells" too, huh?

790651811.text: In any case, let's check the situation out first.

790651812.text: That's right! Let's stay focused and keep our eyes peeled!

790651813.text: Before the final round begins, let us take a short break and give our two contestants time to rest.

790651814.text: For the time being, the competition venue will be open to you all, so go forth and jump to your hearts' content! That is what the Rainsong Pond is here for, after all!

790652001.text: Faurobert will surely win the finals. I believe in him!

790652401.text: Faurobert... Just what's going on with you? *sigh*...

790652501.text: Wha... How!? How could this be!? How could Faurobert flub it so badly...

790652601.text: Poor Faurobert. We've squashed that poor froggy flat under the weight of our expectations.

790652602.text: *sigh* If you ask me, winning all the time does a frog no good. The tallest Lotus Head always breaks first, as they say.

790652701.text: Failure is a deep pond indeed, doubt is the choking algae, and avoidance is the shackling sludge.

790652702.text: Faurobert, Faurobert, Faurobert, how are you going to hop out of this one...

790652801.text: Not bad. It seems Faurobert has proven himself. None can doubt the distance of that jump.

790652901.text: What a toadally ribbeting performance! Faurobert's jumped back on top of his game, just like before!

790653001.text: That's great! *sigh* I almost thought Faurobert had just given up. It would've been such a pity if he had...

790653101.text: Faurobert, Faurobert... You must caution yourself, do not again be bound by vines of the mind.

790653102.text: For a paper frog like you to fail on account of such would be simply and utterly ridiculous.

790659901.text: (Timeline represents a frog jumping powerfully over cliffs and the Traveler gliding)
